questions.q:
우리말과 같은 뜻이 되도록 빈칸에 알맞은 말을 고르세요.
그녀는 도시로 이사한 이후로 이야기할 친구가 전혀 없었다.
Since she moved to the city, she has had no friends ____.
o: to talk to
to talk
talking to
to talk to them
talked to
questions.e: talk to a friend처럼 friend는 전치사 to의 목적어라서 to talk 뒤에 to를 꼭 남겨요. to talk만 쓰면 전치사가 빠져서 틀리고, them을 또 쓰면 friends를 두 번 가리키게 돼요.

questions.q:
밑줄 친 to부정사와 쓰임(용법)이 같은 것을 고르세요.
The teacher gave us something interesting to read during the long holiday.
o: I have a lot of work to finish before the meeting starts.
She decided to study abroad after she graduated.
He went to the library to borrow some books.
To learn a foreign language takes a lot of time.
I got up early to catch the first train.
questions.e: to read는 바로 앞의 something을 꾸미는 형용사적 용법이에요. work to finish도 명사 work를 뒤에서 꾸며요. decided to study, To learn은 명사적, to borrow, to catch는 '~하기 위해'의 부사적 용법이에요.

questions.q: 다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장을 고르세요.
o: We need a bigger house to live in because our family has grown.
She has nothing to worry because she studied hard for the test.
Do you have interesting anything to tell me about the trip?
It's time go to bed, so turn off the TV right now.
I have no one to talk when I feel sad at night.
questions.e: live in a house라서 a house to live in으로 전치사를 남긴 첫 문장이 맞아요. nothing to worry about, anything interesting, time to go, no one to talk to로 고쳐야 해요.

questions.q:
밑줄 친 부분과 바꿔 쓸 수 있는 것을 고르세요.
Mina has many friends who will help her when she is in trouble.
o: to help her
to helping her
for help her
helped her
to be helped her
questions.e: '그녀를 도와줄 친구들'은 명사 friends 뒤에 to + 동사원형을 붙여 friends to help her로 써요. 문서의 friends to help her처럼 명사 뒤에서 꾸미는 형용사적 용법이에요.

questions.q:
빈칸에 알맞은 말을 고르세요.
If you have ____, please tell me before the meeting ends.
questions.ko: 할 중요한 말이 있으면 회의가 끝나기 전에 나에게 말해 주세요.
o: anything important to say
important anything to say
anything to say important
anything important saying
important to say anything
questions.e: -thing으로 끝나는 말은 형용사가 먼저, to부정사가 나중에 와요. anything + important + to say 순서예요.

questions.q:
우리말과 같은 뜻이 되도록 빈칸에 알맞은 말을 고르세요.
이제 아이들이 자러 갈 시간이니 TV를 꺼라.
It's time for the children ____, so turn off the TV.
o: to go to bed
go to bed
going to bed
to going to bed
went to bed
questions.e: '~할 시간'은 time 뒤에 to + 동사원형을 붙여요. It's time to leave처럼 to 뒤에는 동사원형 go가 와야 해요.

questions.q: 다음 중 어법상 틀린 문장을 고르세요.
o: She wants a friend to talk when she feels lonely.
I bought something warm to wear in the cold weather.
He has three children to take care of.
We didn't have enough time to finish the project.
There are many places to visit in this city.
questions.e: talk to a friend라서 전치사 to를 남겨야 해요. → She wants a friend to talk to when she feels lonely. take care of처럼 전치사를 남긴 세 번째 문장은 맞아요.

questions.q: 다음 중 어법상 틀린 문장을 고르세요.
o: Do you have special anything to tell me today?
The kids need a ball to play with at the park.
I have a lot of homework to do before dinner.
It's time to say goodbye to our teacher.
She has a plan to visit her grandmother next week.
questions.e: -thing으로 끝나는 말은 형용사가 뒤에 와요. → Do you have anything special to tell me today?

questions.q: 다음 중 어법상 틀린 문장을 고르세요.
o: There is nothing to be afraid in the dark.
She has no one to depend on in this town.
He is the first student to arrive at school every morning.
We need a box to put these old books in.
I want something sweet to eat after lunch.
questions.e: be afraid of something이라서 전치사 of를 남겨야 해요. → There is nothing to be afraid of in the dark. depend on, put ... in처럼 전치사를 남긴 문장들은 맞아요.

questions.q:
괄호 안의 말을 알맞게 배열하여 빈칸에 쓰세요. (세 단어)
Since he moved here, he hasn't had anyone ____. (with, to, play)
questions.ko: 그는 여기로 이사 온 이후로 같이 놀 사람이 없었다.
questions.e: play with a friend라서 anyone을 꾸미는 to play 뒤에 전치사 with를 남겨요.

questions.q:
두 문장이 같은 뜻이 되도록 빈칸에 알맞은 말을 쓰세요. (두 단어)
I have some work. I must finish it today.
= I have some work ____ today.
questions.ko: 나는 오늘 끝내야 할 일이 좀 있다.
questions.e: '끝내야 할 일'은 명사 work 뒤에 to + 동사원형을 붙여 work to finish로 써요. 명사 뒤에서 꾸미는 형용사적 용법이에요.

questions.q:
우리말과 같은 뜻이 되도록 괄호 안의 말을 이용하여 빈칸에 쓰세요. (네 단어)
Could you give me ____? (something, sit)
questions.e: something 뒤에 to sit을 붙이고, sit on something이라서 전치사 on을 끝에 남겨요.

questions.q: She is looking for a house to live with her family.
questions.ko: 그녀는 가족과 함께 살 집을 찾고 있다.
questions.e: live in a house라서 to live 뒤에 전치사 in을 남겨야 해요. to live → to live in

questions.q: I don't have warm anything to wear because I lost my coat.
questions.ko: 나는 코트를 잃어버려서 입을 따뜻한 것이 하나도 없다.
questions.e: -thing으로 끝나는 말은 형용사가 뒤에 오고 그다음에 to부정사가 와요. warm anything → anything warm

questions.q: Ryan needs someone to talk when he has a problem.
questions.ko: 라이언은 문제가 있을 때 이야기할 누군가가 필요하다.
questions.e: talk to someone이라서 someone을 꾸미는 to talk 뒤에 전치사 to를 남겨야 해요. to talk → to talk to

questions.ko: 나는 여행이 시작되기 전에 해야 할 일이 많다.
ans: I have a lot of things to do before the trip begins.
Before the trip begins, I have a lot of things to do.
questions.e: '해야 할 일'은 things 뒤에 to do를 붙여요. 명사 + to부정사 순서로 쓰고, before절은 뒤에 잇거나 앞에 둘 수 있어요.

questions.ko: 그녀는 어제 가게에서 마실 차가운 것을 샀다.
questions.cond: 주어진 말을 이용하고, 필요하면 단어를 더하거나 형태를 바꾸세요.
ans: She bought something cold to drink at the store yesterday.
Yesterday she bought something cold to drink at the store.
She bought something cold to drink yesterday at the store.
questions.e: yesterday가 있으니 buy를 과거형 bought로 쓰고, something + cold + to drink 순서로 '마실 차가운 것'을 만들어요.

questions.ko: 오늘 밤 TV에는 볼 만한 재미있는 것이 없다.
ans: There is nothing interesting to watch on TV tonight.
There is nothing interesting on TV tonight to watch.
On TV tonight, there is nothing interesting to watch.
questions.e: nothing 뒤에 형용사 interesting이 먼저, to watch가 나중에 와요. -thing + 형용사 + to부정사 순서예요.
